title: Completion-normalized trace tensor shift square
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, schemes X,Y, a morphism f:X→Y with compactification c, normalized ringed models d, and an arbitrary integral object T on X. Use the projection/trace maps of [def-pur-adic-projection-trace-data] and signed tensor shifts of [def-pur-integral-operation-shift-data]. Assume chi at (P_c T,K) is invertible for every finite-Tor constructible integral K on Y. For every t:P_c T→1 and such K, the ordinary-tensor trace transported through chi and the actual left unitor satisfies adicTraceTensor_(K[1]); adicInputShift_K = completedTensor(1,adicInputShift_K); signedRightShift_(P_cT,K); adicTraceTensor_K[1]. This asserts only the trace tensor square, without a projection square, invertibility of a projection, a finite-Tor condition on T, or an exceptional transpose.

proof.text: On flat-term K-flat representatives, the second tensor shift multiplies first degree a by (-1)^a. A degree-zero cochain map t preserves a, so this scalar commutes with t tensor identity. The unit is in degree zero and its unitor has coefficient one, hence the unitor preserves the same square.

Use the normalized completion tensor model from [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge]. The quotient augmentation has the displayed tensor in its product coordinates and zero shifted-cone coordinate. The normalized signed right shift has the same product reindexing and cone diagonal on both routes. Descend on K-flat models, cancel the invertible chi at these inputs, and apply naturality at the fully faithful inclusion shift comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem adicTraceTensorShift {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (d : RingedModels l E) (c : Compactification f)
    (T : Integral l E X)
    (hχ : ∀ K : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory l E Y,
      IsIso (((d.tensor Y).chi l E).app
        ((PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) c).obj T, K.obj)))
    (t : (PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) c).obj T ⟶
      (calculus l E Y).integralClosed.monoidal.tensorUnit)
    (K : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory l E Y) :
    adicTraceTensor l E d c T (K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧).obj (hχ (K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)) t ≫
        (adicInputShift l E Y K).hom =
      (integralCompletedTensor l E Y).map
          (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _) (adicInputShift l E Y K).hom) ≫
        ((tensorShifts l E).integralRight Y 1).hom.app
          ((PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) c).obj T, K.obj) ≫
        (adicTraceTensor l E d c T K.obj (hχ K) t)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'
